summary_md: **Enrico Tartarotti ([@EnriTarta](https://x.com/EnriTarta/status/2115418480010817846))** compared 10,000+ videos on flask.do: teams editing with agents (Claude Code, HyperFrames, Remotion) produce 2.65 versions per video versus 1.23, land a new version a median 16 minutes after feedback versus 11 hours, and leave fewer but more often recorded comments.

referenced_urls.title: Flask - Video Review Workspace for Teams and Agents

relevance: Real usage data on how agentic video editing changes iteration speed and feedback style.
